caption: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with red rim and green dragon pattern, a halved egg, menma bamboo shoots, and a white ceramic spoon are arranged on a smooth red table.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange-red yolk surrounded by a pale, firm white with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
